intent.raw_query: Maldives honeymoon for 2, $5000 budget, snorkeling and luxury resorts, March 2026

experiences.name: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise
experiences.description: Embark on a traditional Maldivian wooden boat (dhoni) decorated with flowers and candles for a private sunset cruise with your partner. Enjoy champagne, fresh tropical fruits, and canapés while watching the sky turn shades of orange and pink over the Indian Ocean. The crew can arrange a floating dinner setup on calm waters for an unforgettable romantic evening.
experiences.location: North Malé Atoll, around Veligandu or Baros Island

experiences.name: Coral Reef Snorkeling at Banana Reef
experiences.description: Explore one of the Maldives' most famous and vibrant coral reefs, teeming with sea turtles, reef sharks, moray eels, and hundreds of tropical fish species. Banana Reef is ideal for snorkelers of all levels with its shallow entry points and crystal-clear visibility. Guided tours include equipment rental, a marine biologist briefing, and underwater photography services.

experiences.name: Underwater Spa Treatment for Two
experiences.description: Indulge in a couples' spa experience at an underwater glass-walled treatment room surrounded by the turquoise lagoon and tropical fish. Choose from signature Maldivian massages using coconut oil and local herbs. This ultra-luxurious experience is the pinnacle of honeymoon pampering and is available at select overwater spa pavilions across premium resorts.
experiences.location: Huvafen Fushi Resort, North Malé Atoll

experiences.name: Maldivian Cooking Class & Local Food Tour
experiences.description: Discover the rich culinary heritage of the Maldives with a hands-on cooking class led by a local chef. Learn to prepare traditional dishes like Mas Huni (tuna and coconut salad), Garudhiya (fish broth), and Bis Keemiya (stuffed pastries). The experience includes a visit to a local fishing village market to source fresh ingredients and ends with a romantic candlelit dinner featuring your creations.

experiences.name: Bioluminescent Night Snorkeling Experience
experiences.description: Witness the magical phenomenon of bioluminescent plankton lighting up the ocean in electric blue as you snorkel after dark. A guided night snorkeling tour takes you to a secluded lagoon where the water glows with every movement, creating a surreal and deeply romantic experience. Wetsuits, torches, and safety equipment are provided, and the tour concludes with stargazing on a sandbank.

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Maldives
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight arrives at 13:00
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Velana International Airport at 13:00. Complete immigration and customs. Take a budget-friendly public ferry or shared speedboat transfer to your island. Check in to Aegean Bliss Resort, Maldives (Beachfront room). Freshen up and take a leisurely stroll along the beachfront to get your bearings and soak in the first views of the turquoise lagoon.
day_by_day.evening: Watch your first Maldivian sunset from the beach in front of the resort. Explore the resort grounds and nearby local area. Enjoy a relaxed welcome dinner at the resort's most affordable dining option or a nearby local café.

meals.breakfast: Grab a snack or meal at the airport before or after landing — airport food courts offer affordable bites around $8–12.
meals.lunch: Light meal at the airport or on the ferry — pack snacks or grab a local short-eat (samosa, fish roll) from a kiosk for $3–5.
meals.dinner: Dinner at the resort's casual beachside restaurant — opt for the set menu or local Maldivian fish curry with rice, around $12–18 per person.

day_by_day.notes: Book your ferry or shared speedboat transfer in advance to save money vs. private speedboats. Keep your first evening light — you've had a long travel day. Exchange currency or use ATM at the airport for Maldivian Rufiyaa (MVR) for local purchases.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning beach walk at sunrise — completely free and incredibly romantic. After sunrise, enjoy breakfast at the resort. Head to the resort's house reef for your first snorkeling session of the trip. Most beachfront resorts provide basic snorkel gear — confirm with the resort if it's complimentary or rent for a small fee ($5–10).
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue snorkeling at the house reef or relax on the beachfront. Explore the shallow lagoon and look for colorful reef fish, sea turtles, and coral formations. In the mid-afternoon, take a short walk to the local island village nearby (if accessible) to experience authentic Maldivian life and pick up local souvenirs at budget-friendly prices.
day_by_day.evening: Romantic beachside sunset picnic — buy fresh fruit, local snacks, and drinks from the local shop and set up on the beach. After sunset, enjoy a candlelit dinner at the resort or a local restaurant on the island.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast buffet if included in your package, or order à la carte — fresh tropical fruit platter, eggs, and local flatbread (roshi) with tuna paste ($8–12).
meals.lunch: Local tea house (sai hotel) lunch — traditional Maldivian short eats like mas huni (tuna and coconut), garudhiya (fish broth soup) with rice, around $4–7.
meals.dinner: Grilled fresh catch of the day at a local island restaurant or resort casual dining — approximately $15–20 per person.

day_by_day.notes: Maldivian house reefs are often the best snorkeling spots and are free to access. Apply reef-safe sunscreen to protect the coral ecosystem. Modest dress is required when visiting local islands — carry a sarong or cover-up.

day_by_day.morning: Morning snorkeling session at a nearby snorkeling hotspot — ask the resort to recommend the best reef spots reachable by a short swim or kayak. Look for reef sharks, manta rays, and vibrant coral gardens. Return for a mid-morning rest on the beach.
day_by_day.afternoon: Rent a kayak from the resort or a local rental shop ($10–15/hour) and paddle around the lagoon together — a perfect romantic activity. Explore the sandbanks visible from the shore. In the late afternoon, visit the local island's fish market (if available) to see the daily catch being brought in — a fascinating cultural experience.
day_by_day.evening: Stargaze from the beach — the Maldives has minimal light pollution, making for spectacular night skies. Enjoy a quiet romantic evening on your beachfront.

meals.breakfast: Mas huni with roshi (traditional Maldivian breakfast of shredded smoked tuna with coconut and chili) at a local tea house — $3–5.
meals.lunch: Pack a picnic lunch from the local shop — bread, canned tuna, fresh coconut, tropical fruits — $5–8 total.
meals.dinner: Barbecue night at the resort beach — many budget resorts offer weekly BBQ evenings with fresh seafood; look for set-price deals around $18–25 per person.

day_by_day.notes: Kayak rentals are significantly cheaper than motorized water sports. Early morning and late afternoon are the best times for snorkeling as the light is better and sea life is more active. Check with the resort for any complimentary evening activities.

day_by_day.morning: Join a budget group snorkeling trip organized by the resort or a local dive center — these shared tours typically visit 2–3 reef sites and cost $25–40 per person, far cheaper than private charters. Spot eagle rays, turtles, and diverse reef fish.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return from the snorkeling excursion and relax on the beach. Enjoy a romantic couple's massage if the resort offers affordable spa packages — look for local spa deals or short 30-minute sessions ($30–50 per person). Alternatively, simply lounge on the beach and read.
day_by_day.evening: Explore the resort's beachfront in the evening. Look out for bioluminescent plankton in the shallows after dark — a magical, free natural phenomenon often visible in the Maldives. Walk along the water's edge to spot the glowing blue light.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast — fresh tropical juice, scrambled eggs, toast, and local tuna curry ($10–14).
meals.lunch: Snack on the snorkeling boat (usually included) or grab a quick bite at a local tea house upon return — fish rolls and samosas for $3–5.
meals.dinner: Try a local Maldivian curry dinner at an island restaurant — chicken or fish curry with rice and fresh salad, $10–15 per person.

day_by_day.notes: Book group snorkeling tours at least a day in advance through the resort or local operators. Bioluminescence is best seen on dark, moonless nights — check the lunar calendar. Bring an underwater camera or a waterproof phone case for snorkeling photos.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise yoga or meditation on the beach — many resorts offer free or low-cost morning wellness sessions. If not available, practice on your own on the beachfront. After yoga, go for a morning swim in the crystal-clear lagoon.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a nearby uninhabited sandbank — arrange a budget sandbank excursion through the resort or local boat operators ($20–35 per couple for a short trip). Spend the afternoon on a pristine private sandbank surrounded by nothing but ocean — the ultimate romantic Maldivian experience.
day_by_day.evening: Return from the sandbank and freshen up. Enjoy a romantic sunset from the beach with a local coconut drink. Head to dinner at the resort or a nearby restaurant.

meals.breakfast: Light and healthy — fresh fruit bowl, yogurt, and local honey from the resort café ($7–10).
meals.lunch: Pack lunch for the sandbank — sandwiches, fresh fruits, coconut water, and local snacks prepared from the local shop ($6–9 total).
meals.dinner: Splurge slightly on a nicer dinner tonight to celebrate the romantic sandbank experience — fresh grilled lobster or seafood platter at the resort, $25–35 per person.

day_by_day.notes: Sandbank trips are one of the most iconic and romantic Maldives experiences — worth the splurge. Bring plenty of reef-safe sunscreen, hats, and water as there is no shade on a sandbank. Negotiate with local boat operators for the best price — group rates are cheaper.

day_by_day.morning: Spend the morning snorkeling at the house reef at your own pace — no tour, no cost. Focus on underwater photography if you have a waterproof camera. Look for nudibranchs, octopus, and smaller reef creatures you may have missed on group tours.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take a self-guided walk around the local island. Visit the local school, mosque (from outside respectfully), and community areas to understand local Maldivian culture. Shop for affordable local crafts — lacquerware, woven mats, and handmade jewelry make great honeymoon mementos.
day_by_day.evening: Beach bonfire (if permitted by the resort) or a quiet evening stargazing on the beach. Enjoy a romantic walk along the shoreline after dinner.

meals.breakfast: Local tea house breakfast — roshi with egg curry and sweet milk tea (sai), $3–5.
meals.lunch: Local island restaurant — garudhiya (fish broth) with rice, lime, and chili, $5–8.
meals.dinner: Cook-your-own or BBQ option if the resort offers it, or a hearty local dinner with grilled fish, coconut rice, and tropical salad, $12–16 per person.

day_by_day.notes: Always ask permission before photographing local residents. Dress modestly when exploring local islands. Buying local crafts directly from artisans supports the community and is more affordable than resort gift shops.

day_by_day.morning: Join a budget dolphin-watching cruise — local operators offer shared morning cruises for $20–35 per person. Spinner dolphins are commonly spotted in the Maldives and it's a truly magical experience, especially as a couple.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return from the dolphin cruise and spend the afternoon relaxing on the beach. Enjoy a refreshing coconut drink from a local vendor. Take a nap, read, or simply enjoy the beachfront ambiance — sometimes the best Maldives moments are the simplest ones.
day_by_day.evening: Midpoint of the trip celebration — enjoy a slightly elevated dinner experience. Many resorts offer a 'feet in the sand' dining experience on the beach — check if the resort offers this and book in advance. Watch the stars appear over the Indian Ocean.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast or local tea house — tropical fruit, eggs, and local tuna paste with flatbread, $5–12.
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the resort's beach café — fish burger or fresh salad wrap, $10–14.
meals.dinner: Special mid-trip dinner — beach dining with candles, fresh seafood, and tropical dessert. Look for resort set-menu deals, $25–40 per person.

day_by_day.notes: Dolphin sightings are not guaranteed but very common in the Maldives — morning cruises at sunrise have the highest success rate. This is the halfway point of your trip — take stock of your budget and adjust spending for the second week if needed.

day_by_day.morning: Morning free dive or snorkeling session at a new reef spot recommended by the resort. Try to explore a slightly deeper section of the reef if you're a confident swimmer — the coral walls and drop-offs are spectacular. Spend at least 2 hours in the water.
day_by_day.afternoon: Rent stand-up paddleboards (SUP) from the resort or local rental ($15–20/hour) and explore the lagoon from a different perspective. SUP is a fun, romantic activity for couples and gives a great view of the underwater world below. Return boards and relax on the beach.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a quiet evening at the resort. Browse photos from the week so far. Have a casual dinner and an early night to recharge for the days ahead.

meals.breakfast: Energizing breakfast before snorkeling — eggs, whole grain toast, fresh juice, and a banana, $8–12.
meals.lunch: Local tea house — short eats platter (mix of fish rolls, samosas, and bajiya), $4–6.
meals.dinner: Casual resort dinner — pasta, grilled chicken, or vegetarian option with fresh bread, $12–16 per person.

day_by_day.notes: Stand-up paddleboarding is easier in calm lagoon conditions — early morning or late afternoon is best when winds are minimal. Stay hydrated — the tropical sun is intense even when you're in or near the water.

day_by_day.morning: Take a budget day trip to a nearby inhabited local island — arrange a shared speedboat or public ferry transfer ($5–15 per person). Explore the island's local market, cafés, and beach. This offers a fascinating contrast to the resort experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Snorkel at the local island's reef or beach — local islands often have excellent, uncrowded reefs. Have lunch at a local tea house on the island. Browse local shops for affordable souvenirs and gifts.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Aegean Bliss Resort by late afternoon/early evening. Freshen up and enjoy a relaxed dinner at the resort. Share stories and photos from the day trip over dinner.

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast at the resort before departure — keep it light and quick, $8–10.
meals.lunch: Authentic local island lunch at a tea house — full Maldivian meal with fish curry, rice, salad, and tea, $5–8 per person.
meals.dinner: Resort dinner — treat yourself to a fresh fish dish after a full day of exploring, $14–18 per person.

day_by_day.notes: Check public ferry schedules in advance — they run on fixed timetables and are the most budget-friendly inter-island transport. Carry cash in Maldivian Rufiyaa for local island purchases as cards may not be accepted everywhere.

day_by_day.morning: Dedicated underwater photography morning — spend 2–3 hours snorkeling at the house reef focusing on capturing the best photos and videos. If you don't have an underwater camera, many local dive shops rent GoPros for $15–20/day.
day_by_day.afternoon: Relaxing beach afternoon — set up on the beachfront with a good book, tropical drinks, and enjoy the sounds of the ocean. This is your rest day before the final push of the trip. Take a leisurely swim in the lagoon.
day_by_day.evening: Romantic evening walk along the beach at sunset. Collect shells and coral fragments (only dead ones from the beach — never take living coral). Enjoy a quiet, intimate dinner for two.

meals.breakfast: Healthy smoothie bowl or fresh fruit platter at the resort café, $8–10.
meals.lunch: Light beach snack — fresh coconut, tropical fruits, and local snacks from the resort shop, $5–8.
meals.dinner: Romantic dinner for two at the resort — request a private table on the beach if available, fresh grilled fish with coconut rice and tropical dessert, $20–28 per person.

day_by_day.notes: GoPro rentals from local dive shops are much cheaper than buying one. Ask the resort about complimentary beach setup services for romantic evenings — some budget resorts offer this at no extra charge.

day_by_day.morning: Last major snorkeling excursion — join a group reef snorkeling tour to a different reef system you haven't visited yet. Many operators offer 'best of' tours covering the top snorkeling sites in the area ($30–45 per person for a half-day group tour).
day_by_day.afternoon: Return from the snorkeling tour. Spend the afternoon at the resort's beach, reflecting on the trip. Begin thinking about packing and organizing souvenirs. Enjoy a refreshing dip in the lagoon one more time.
day_by_day.evening: Penultimate night celebration — enjoy a special dinner. Many resorts offer romantic dinner packages for honeymooners — inquire at the front desk about any special arrangements or discounts for couples.

meals.breakfast: Full resort breakfast to fuel the snorkeling excursion — eggs, fresh juice, tropical fruits, toast, $10–14.
meals.lunch: Included on the snorkeling tour or grab a quick local bite upon return, $0–8.
meals.dinner: Honeymoon special dinner — check for resort romantic dining packages with wine/mocktails, multi-course seafood meal, $35–50 per couple (worth the splurge for the occasion).

day_by_day.notes: Ask the resort in advance about honeymoon/romance packages — even budget resorts often offer complimentary rose petals, candles, or dessert platters for honeymooning couples at no extra cost. This is the time to use any remaining budget for a memorable final experience.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise on the beach — wake up early for one last magical Maldivian sunrise together. Take plenty of photos and videos to capture the memory. Last swim in the crystal-clear lagoon.
day_by_day.afternoon: Complete packing and check-out procedures. Store luggage with the resort concierge. Spend the remaining hours exploring the beach, buying any last-minute souvenirs from the local shop, and saying goodbye to the island. Enjoy one final coconut on the beach.
day_by_day.evening: Transfer to the airport or ferry terminal depending on your onward travel. Enjoy a farewell dinner at the resort or airport before departure. Reflect on 13 incredible days in paradise.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast — go all out with the full spread, fresh tropical fruits, eggs, local pastries, $10–14.
meals.lunch: Light farewell lunch at the resort or local tea house — keep it simple with local short eats and tea, $5–8.
meals.dinner: Airport restaurant or resort farewell dinner — Maldivian fish curry one last time, $12–18 per person.

day_by_day.notes: Confirm your departure transfer and flight details the day before. Allow extra time for ferry/speedboat transfers to the airport. Keep some Maldivian Rufiyaa for tips and last-minute purchases. Check if the resort offers a late check-out option to maximize your final day.

day_by_day.morning: Departure day — if flight is later in the day, enjoy a final morning at the resort or explore the airport area. Velana International Airport has a small shopping area and cafés. Collect any duty-free items.
day_by_day.afternoon: Board your flight home with incredible memories of 13 days in the Maldives — snorkeling adventures, romantic sunsets, pristine sandbanks, and the unmatched beauty of the Indian Ocean.
day_by_day.evening: In-flight — review your photos and videos, plan how to share your honeymoon memories, and start dreaming about your next adventure.

meals.breakfast: Airport café breakfast — continental or local option, $8–12.
meals.lunch: Airport restaurant or in-flight meal — $10–15 or included with flight.
meals.dinner: In-flight dinner included with your LH flight service.

day_by_day.notes: Final budget recap: aim to have spent approximately $80–120 per person per day including accommodation, meals, and activities for a truly budget-conscious Maldives experience. Total estimated trip cost for two: $2,100–$3,100 excluding flights and accommodation base cost. Tips: always negotiate, use public ferries, eat at local tea houses, and join group tours rather than private ones to maximize savings without sacrificing the magic of the Maldives.

trip_options.description: The sweet spot between comfort and value. Enjoy quality accommodations, diverse experiences, and good food.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight arrives at 13:00
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Malé International Airport at 13:00. Clear immigration and customs, then meet the Aegean Bliss Resort transfer representative. Board the resort's speedboat or seaplane transfer to the resort. Check in to your Beachfront accommodation, freshen up, and take a leisurely stroll along the beach to get oriented. Enjoy a welcome drink and explore the resort facilities at a relaxed pace.
day_by_day.evening: Watch your first Maldivian sunset from the beachfront. Head to the resort's main restaurant for a romantic welcome dinner for two, toasting to the start of your honeymoon escape.

meals.breakfast: Meal on the flight
meals.lunch: Light snacks or a casual bite at the resort's beach bar upon arrival
meals.dinner: Welcome dinner at Aegean Bliss Resort's main restaurant — opt for the set dinner menu featuring fresh Maldivian seafood (approx. $50–$70 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Day 1 activities begin only after arrival at 13:00. Keep the evening relaxed to recover from travel. Confirm all upcoming experience bookings with the resort concierge upon check-in.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a leisurely breakfast at the resort's beachfront restaurant. Afterward, take your first snorkeling session directly from the beach in front of Aegean Bliss Resort — the house reef is typically accessible steps from the shore. Spot colorful reef fish, parrotfish, and possibly reef sharks in the calm morning waters.
day_by_day.afternoon: Join the guided Coral Reef Snorkeling at Banana Reef experience — one of the Maldives' most iconic dive sites teeming with sea turtles, reef sharks, and vibrant coral formations. A resort boat will take you to the site. Spend 1.5–2 hours exploring the reef with a knowledgeable guide.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort and relax on your beachfront terrace. Enjoy a sundowner cocktail at the overwater bar as the sky turns golden. Dine at the resort's à la carte seafood restaurant for a romantic dinner under the stars.

meals.breakfast: Full buffet breakfast at the resort's beachfront restaurant — included or approx. $20–$30 per person
meals.lunch: Casual beachside lunch at the resort's beach shack — grilled fish sandwich, fresh fruit, and coconut water (approx. $20–$30 per person)
meals.dinner: À la carte dinner at the resort's seafood restaurant — grilled lobster, tuna carpaccio, and local desserts (approx. $60–$80 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Book the Banana Reef snorkeling excursion through the resort concierge the evening before. Bring reef-safe sunscreen, and consider a rash guard for extended sun exposure.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a slow, romantic morning. Have breakfast delivered to your beachfront villa for an intimate experience. Afterward, take a gentle kayaking session along the lagoon — kayaks are usually available through the resort's water sports center at no extra charge or a small fee.
day_by_day.afternoon: Treat yourselves to the Underwater Spa Treatment for Two — an extraordinary couples' spa experience inside a glass-walled underwater treatment room surrounded by marine life. This signature experience typically lasts 90 minutes to 2 hours and includes massages, aromatherapy, and breathtaking views of the reef below.
day_by_day.evening: After the spa, enjoy a light early evening swim in the resort pool or the lagoon. Head to the resort's wine and tapas lounge for pre-dinner drinks. Dine at the resort's main restaurant and try the Maldivian tasting menu.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast service — fresh tropical fruits, pastries, eggs, and Maldivian black tea (approx. $25–$35 per person or included in some packages)
meals.lunch: Poolside lunch at the resort — light salads, wraps, and fresh juices (approx. $20–$25 per person)
meals.dinner: Maldivian tasting menu at the resort's main restaurant — mas huni, garudhiya fish soup, and coconut-based desserts (approx. $55–$75 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Book the Underwater Spa Treatment well in advance as it is a highly sought-after experience with limited slots. Avoid heavy meals before the spa session.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning snorkeling session from the beach to catch the best visibility and marine activity before other guests are out. Look for octopuses, moray eels, and Napoleon wrasse along the house reef. Return for a hearty breakfast at the resort.
day_by_day.afternoon: Embark on the Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise (scheduled for late afternoon into the evening). In the meantime, spend the afternoon relaxing on the beach — read, sunbathe, or simply enjoy the turquoise lagoon. Visit the resort's boutique to pick up a souvenir or two.
day_by_day.evening: Board your Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise — a traditional Maldivian wooden dhoni decorated with tropical flowers and candles. Sail across the Indian Ocean as the sun dips below the horizon, sipping champagne and enjoying canapes prepared by the resort chef. A truly magical, intimate honeymoon experience.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast at the resort restaurant — eggs, fresh tropical fruits, cereals, and local pastries (approx. $20–$30 per person)
meals.lunch: Beachfront picnic-style lunch — packed by the resort with sandwiches, fruit, and cold drinks enjoyed on a quiet stretch of beach (approx. $20 per person)
meals.dinner: Canapes and champagne included on the Dhoni Cruise. Follow with a late dinner at the resort's overwater bar restaurant — light grilled fish and salads (approx. $40–$55 per person)

day_by_day.notes: The Sunset Dhoni Cruise typically departs 1–1.5 hours before sunset. Confirm the exact departure time with the concierge based on the day's sunset schedule. Bring a light wrap or shawl as it can get breezy on the water.

day_by_day.morning: Join the Maldivian Cooking Class & Local Food Tour — a hands-on culinary experience led by a local chef. Learn to prepare traditional dishes such as mas huni (tuna and coconut salad), fihunu mas (grilled spiced fish), and bondi (Maldivian bread). Explore the use of local spices, coconut, and fresh tuna — staples of Maldivian cuisine.
day_by_day.afternoon: After the cooking class, enjoy the lunch you prepared together. Spend the rest of the afternoon at leisure — lounge by the pool, enjoy a couple's massage at the resort spa (standard treatment), or simply nap in a hammock on the beach.
day_by_day.evening: Dress up for a romantic dinner on the beach — arrange a private candlelit dining setup through the resort for a special honeymoon experience. Many mid-range resorts offer this for a reasonable surcharge.

meals.breakfast: Light breakfast at the resort before the cooking class — fresh fruit, yogurt, and coffee (approx. $15–$20 per person)
meals.lunch: Dishes prepared during the cooking class — an authentic, memorable meal included in the experience cost
meals.dinner: Private candlelit beach dinner arranged through the resort — a curated 3-course menu with wine pairing (approx. $80–$120 per person including setup surcharge)

day_by_day.notes: The cooking class is a wonderful way to connect with Maldivian culture. Take photos of your dishes and ask the chef for recipe cards to bring home as a honeymoon memento.

day_by_day.morning: Take a morning snorkeling trip to a nearby sandbank or lagoon organized by the resort. Many resorts offer guided excursions to pristine, less-visited snorkeling spots away from the main reef. Look for manta rays and eagle rays in the open water between atolls.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort and enjoy a relaxing afternoon. Visit the resort's infinity pool overlooking the ocean. Treat yourselves to a refreshing coconut drink and read or nap on sun loungers. Optional: try stand-up paddleboarding (SUP) in the calm lagoon.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a casual dinner at the resort's beach bar — a more laid-back, budget-friendly option compared to the fine dining restaurant. Great for enjoying fresh grilled fish, local curries, and cold Maldivian beer.

meals.breakfast: Full buffet breakfast at the resort (approx. $20–$30 per person)
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the pool bar — fish tacos, fresh salads, and smoothies (approx. $20–$25 per person)
meals.dinner: Casual dinner at the resort's beach bar — grilled barracuda, coconut rice, and local curry (approx. $35–$50 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Ask the resort's dive center about guided snorkeling to manta ray cleaning stations — March is an excellent time of year for manta ray sightings in the Maldives.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recharge — enjoy a slow morning on your private beachfront. Have breakfast in bed or on your terrace. Reflect on the first week of your honeymoon. Take a long, unhurried swim in the warm Indian Ocean.
day_by_day.afternoon: Optional half-day excursion to a nearby local island (if available from the resort's excursion desk) to experience authentic Maldivian village life, visit a local mosque, and browse small craft shops for handmade souvenirs. This offers a cultural contrast to the resort bubble.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort in time for sunset. Enjoy cocktails at the overwater bar. Dine at the resort's fine dining restaurant for a mid-trip celebratory dinner — try the chef's special tasting menu.

meals.breakfast: In-villa or terrace breakfast — fresh tropical fruits, eggs to order, and Maldivian tea (approx. $25–$35 per person)
meals.lunch: Local tea house lunch on the nearby island — fresh roshi (flatbread), hedhikaa (short eats), and local fish curry (approx. $10–$15 per person — very affordable on local islands)
meals.dinner: Chef's tasting menu at the resort's fine dining restaurant — 5-course menu with wine pairing (approx. $90–$120 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Dress modestly when visiting local islands — cover shoulders and knees out of respect for the local Muslim culture. Bring cash in Maldivian Rufiyaa or USD for local island purchases.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning dolphin watching cruise — depart just after sunrise when dolphin pods are most active. The waters around most Maldivian atolls are home to spinner dolphins that love to ride bow waves. A joyful and magical experience to share as a couple.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort for a late breakfast or brunch. Spend the afternoon at the resort's spa — book individual treatments such as a Maldivian coconut oil massage or a hot stone therapy session. Enjoy the steam room and relaxation lounge.
day_by_day.evening: Stroll along the beach at dusk, collecting shells. Enjoy a quiet dinner at the resort's casual dining venue — a more relaxed mid-range option for a rest evening.

meals.breakfast: Brunch at the resort upon return from the dolphin cruise — eggs benedict, fresh juices, and pastries (approx. $25–$35 per person)
meals.lunch: Light snack at the spa's wellness café — smoothie bowls, herbal teas, and energy bites (approx. $15–$20 per person)
meals.dinner: Casual resort dining — wood-fired pizza, pasta, and a shared dessert platter (approx. $35–$50 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Dolphin watching excursions are typically offered by the resort's water sports or excursion team. Book the evening before. Bring a camera with a good zoom lens for dolphin photos.

day_by_day.morning: Second Coral Reef Snorkeling session — revisit Banana Reef or explore a different reef site recommended by the resort's marine biologist or dive instructor. Focus on underwater photography if you have a waterproof camera or GoPro.
day_by_day.afternoon: Relax on the beach and enjoy water sports — try windsurfing or a banana boat ride for a fun, playful afternoon. Visit the resort's gift shop to begin selecting souvenirs and gifts to bring home.
day_by_day.evening: Experience the Bioluminescent Night Snorkeling Experience — one of the most awe-inspiring natural phenomena in the Maldives. Wade into the dark ocean and witness the electric blue glow of bioluminescent plankton lighting up around your every movement. A truly unforgettable honeymoon memory.

meals.breakfast: Full buffet breakfast at the resort (approx. $20–$30 per person)
meals.lunch: Beachside BBQ lunch at the resort — grilled prawns, corn on the cob, and fresh fruit (approx. $25–$35 per person)
meals.dinner: Early light dinner before the night snorkeling experience — grilled fish, rice, and salad at the resort's casual restaurant (approx. $35–$45 per person). Avoid heavy meals before entering the water.

day_by_day.notes: The bioluminescent night snorkeling experience is weather and tide dependent — confirm with the resort on the day. Best experienced on a new moon night when skies are darkest. Absolutely no flash photography as it disturbs the plankton.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a peaceful morning yoga session on the beach (many resorts offer complimentary or low-cost sunrise yoga). Afterward, take a long swim or float in the lagoon together, savoring the tranquility of the Maldivian morning.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the resort's marine education center or attend a coral planting workshop if offered — a meaningful and eco-conscious activity that contributes to reef conservation. A unique experience to participate in together as a couple.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a second Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise if you loved the first, or opt for a sunset cocktail hour at the resort's overwater bar. Dine at the resort's beachfront restaurant under a canopy of stars.

meals.breakfast: Light post-yoga breakfast — açaí bowls, fresh coconut, and herbal tea at the resort's wellness café (approx. $15–$20 per person)
meals.lunch: Casual lunch at the resort's beach shack — fish burgers, sweet potato fries, and fresh lime juice (approx. $20–$30 per person)
meals.dinner: Romantic dinner at the resort's beachfront restaurant — fresh catch of the day, lobster bisque, and a shared chocolate fondant dessert (approx. $60–$80 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Coral planting workshops are a wonderful way to give back to the Maldivian ecosystem. Ask the resort's sustainability team about their conservation programs.

day_by_day.morning: Indulge in a full morning of pure relaxation — no activities planned. Sleep in, have a leisurely breakfast, and spend the morning reading, sunbathing, or floating in the lagoon. This is your honeymoon — rest is sacred.
day_by_day.afternoon: Book a second Underwater Spa Treatment for Two or opt for a different couples' treatment at the resort spa — perhaps a Javanese lulur scrub or a tropical flower bath ritual. Spend the rest of the afternoon in the spa's relaxation lounge.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a farewell-style romantic dinner — even though you have two nights left, treat this as a special evening to celebrate your honeymoon journey. Request a table with the best view at the resort's signature restaurant.

meals.breakfast: Full à la carte breakfast in bed — eggs, fresh tropical fruits, pastries, and Maldivian coffee (approx. $30–$40 per person)
meals.lunch: Poolside lunch — mezze platter, hummus, grilled vegetables, and sparkling water (approx. $20–$30 per person)
meals.dinner: Signature restaurant dinner — tasting menu with local and international fusion dishes, paired with a bottle of white wine (approx. $80–$100 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Use this day to begin packing and organizing your belongings. Confirm your departure transfer details with the resort concierge for Day 13.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning snorkeling session — a fond farewell to the reef and its incredible inhabitants. Spend 1–2 hours in the water, taking in every last detail of the vibrant underwater world you've come to love over the past two weeks.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check out any remaining resort activities you haven't tried — glass-bottom boat tour, jet ski ride, or a final paddleboard session in the lagoon. Visit the resort's boutique for any last-minute souvenir shopping.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a relaxed, nostalgic final dinner at the resort — revisit your favorite dining spot from the trip. Share memories of your favorite moments from the honeymoon over a bottle of champagne.

meals.breakfast: Full buffet breakfast at the resort — make it special with all your favorite items from the trip (approx. $20–$30 per person)
meals.lunch: Light beach lunch — fresh sashimi, avocado toast, and coconut water (approx. $25–$35 per person)
meals.dinner: Final dinner at your favorite resort restaurant — order your most-loved dishes from the trip and toast to your honeymoon with champagne (approx. $60–$80 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Settle your resort bill this evening to avoid a rushed checkout tomorrow. Confirm the exact time of your departure transfer for the following morning.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up early for one last sunrise on the beach — a quiet, intimate moment to close out this extraordinary honeymoon. Take a final walk along the shoreline, collect a handful of sand as a keepsake, and say goodbye to the Indian Ocean.
day_by_day.afternoon: Complete checkout formalities at the resort. Board your departure transfer (speedboat or seaplane) back to Malé International Airport. Arrive at the airport with ample time for check-in and security. Browse duty-free for any final Maldivian gifts — local honey, black coral jewelry, or Maldivian spice blends.
day_by_day.evening: Depart the Maldives carrying 13 days of beautiful honeymoon memories — sunsets, bioluminescent seas, coral reefs, and romantic moments that will last a lifetime.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast at the resort before departure — fresh fruit, toast, and coffee (approx. $15–$20 per person or complimentary with checkout package)
meals.lunch: Lunch at Malé Airport — airport café or restaurant with Maldivian snacks and beverages (approx. $15–$25 per person)
meals.dinner: In-flight meal or dinner at your layover destination

day_by_day.notes: Allow at least 3 hours before your flight for the resort transfer and airport procedures. Seaplane transfers must be completed before dark — confirm transfer timing with the resort well in advance. Keep all travel documents, passports, and boarding passes easily accessible.

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Maldives Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

experiences.name: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise
experiences.description: Embark on a traditional Maldivian wooden boat (dhoni) decorated with flowers and candles for a private sunset cruise with your partner. Enjoy champagne, fresh tropical fruits, and canapés while watching the sky turn shades of orange and pink over the Indian Ocean. The crew can arrange a floating dinner setup on calm waters for an unforgettable romantic evening.
experiences.location: North Malé Atoll, around Veligandu or Baros Island

experiences.name: Coral Reef Snorkeling at Banana Reef
experiences.description: Explore one of the Maldives' most famous and vibrant coral reefs, teeming with sea turtles, reef sharks, moray eels, and hundreds of tropical fish species. Banana Reef is ideal for snorkelers of all levels with its shallow entry points and crystal-clear visibility. Guided tours include equipment rental, a marine biologist briefing, and underwater photography services.

experiences.name: Underwater Spa Treatment for Two
experiences.description: Indulge in a couples' spa experience at an underwater glass-walled treatment room surrounded by the turquoise lagoon and tropical fish. Choose from signature Maldivian massages using coconut oil and local herbs. This ultra-luxurious experience is the pinnacle of honeymoon pampering and is available at select overwater spa pavilions across premium resorts.
experiences.location: Huvafen Fushi Resort, North Malé Atoll

experiences.name: Maldivian Cooking Class & Local Food Tour
experiences.description: Discover the rich culinary heritage of the Maldives with a hands-on cooking class led by a local chef. Learn to prepare traditional dishes like Mas Huni (tuna and coconut salad), Garudhiya (fish broth), and Bis Keemiya (stuffed pastries). The experience includes a visit to a local fishing village market to source fresh ingredients and ends with a romantic candlelit dinner featuring your creations.

experiences.name: Bioluminescent Night Snorkeling Experience
experiences.description: Witness the magical phenomenon of bioluminescent plankton lighting up the ocean in electric blue as you snorkel after dark. A guided night snorkeling tour takes you to a secluded lagoon where the water glows with every movement, creating a surreal and deeply romantic experience. Wetsuits, torches, and safety equipment are provided, and the tour concludes with stargazing on a sandbank.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight arrives at 13:00
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Malé International Airport at 13:00. Meet your dedicated Aegean Bliss Resort butler at the arrival lounge for a seamless VIP welcome. Transfer via private luxury seaplane or speedboat to the resort. Check in to your Beachfront villa with a chilled welcome drink, fresh flower garlands, and a personalized resort orientation. Settle in, freshen up, and take a leisurely stroll along your private beach stretch.
day_by_day.evening: Watch your first Maldivian sunset from your villa's private deck or the resort's overwater sunset bar. Enjoy a romantic candlelit welcome dinner on the beach, specially curated by the resort's executive chef, featuring fresh local seafood and Maldivian-inspired flavors.

meals.breakfast: N/A — in transit
meals.lunch: Light refreshments and canapés served upon arrival at the resort's welcome lounge
meals.dinner: Private candlelit beach dinner at Aegean Bliss Resort — personalized 5-course welcome menu with fresh lobster, grilled reef fish, and a champagne toast (Moët & Chandon or similar)

day_by_day.notes: Ensure all arrival documents, resort transfer confirmations, and villa preferences (rose petals, pillow menu, minibar stocking) are pre-arranged. Request honeymoon decoration package to be set up in the villa before arrival.

day_by_day.morning: Begin the morning with a private in-villa breakfast served on your beachfront terrace as the sun rises over the Indian Ocean. After breakfast, gear up for a guided house reef snorkeling session directly from the resort's beach — explore the vibrant coral gardens, spot reef sharks, colorful parrotfish, and sea turtles in the crystal-clear lagoon waters.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend a luxurious afternoon at the resort's infinity pool with personalized poolside service — chilled towels, fresh tropical juices, and a curated snack menu. Later, book a couples' massage at the resort's overwater spa, incorporating traditional Maldivian techniques with coconut oil and island botanicals.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy the Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise — embark on a traditional Maldivian wooden dhoni decorated with flowers and candles for an intimate sunset sail. Sip champagne, enjoy canapés, and watch the sky transform into shades of gold and crimson over the Indian Ocean.

meals.breakfast: Private in-villa breakfast — tropical fruit platters, eggs Benedict, freshly baked pastries, and Maldivian roshi with fresh coconut sambal
meals.lunch: Poolside dining at the resort's main restaurant — grilled prawn skewers, tuna tartare, and chilled coconut water
meals.dinner: Return from the dhoni cruise and dine at the resort's signature overwater restaurant — a la carte menu featuring seared yellowfin tuna, lobster thermidor, and a curated wine pairing

day_by_day.notes: Pre-book the Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise at least 24 hours in advance through your butler. Confirm snorkeling equipment sizes and any dietary preferences for the dhoni cruise canapés.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early for a guided sunrise yoga session on the beach or your villa deck, led by the resort's wellness instructor. Follow with a nourishing spa breakfast at the wellness pavilion. Then embark on the signature experience — Coral Reef Snorkeling at Banana Reef, one of the Maldives' most iconic dive sites. A private boat transfers you to this UNESCO-protected reef teeming with sea turtles, reef sharks, Napoleon wrasse, and thousands of tropical fish.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort for a leisurely lunch. Spend the afternoon exploring the resort's underwater observatory or glass-floor lounge, watching marine life below. Optional: Take a beginner or refresher scuba diving lesson in the resort's pool with a certified PADI instructor in preparation for future dives.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a romantic sundowner at the resort's sky bar or rooftop terrace. Follow with a private dining experience set up on a sandbank (if available) — a torch-lit table for two surrounded by the ocean on all sides, featuring a bespoke seafood menu.

meals.breakfast: Wellness breakfast at the spa pavilion — acai bowls, green smoothies, smoked salmon on sourdough, and herbal teas
meals.lunch: Light beachside lunch at the resort's beach grill — freshly grilled reef fish tacos, mango salsa, and iced hibiscus tea
meals.dinner: Private sandbank dinner (arranged by butler) — 6-course seafood tasting menu with Maldivian spiced lobster, grilled octopus, and a dedicated sommelier for wine pairing

day_by_day.notes: Banana Reef excursion requires a short boat ride — confirm departure time with the activities desk. Sandbank dinner is weather-dependent and should be booked 48 hours in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a slow morning with a late in-villa breakfast. Participate in the resort's guided dolphin-watching boat excursion — head out into the open ocean to spot spinner dolphins in their natural habitat, often seen leaping and playing in the bow waves. Bring your snorkel gear for an optional swim stop at a pristine outer reef.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort and indulge in the Underwater Spa Treatment for Two — a truly unique couples' spa experience in a glass-walled underwater treatment room. Watch reef fish and coral formations drift past as you both receive synchronized deep tissue massages, followed by a Maldivian coconut body wrap.
day_by_day.evening: Head to the resort's wine cellar bar for a private wine and cheese tasting curated by the sommelier — featuring selections from Burgundy, Tuscany, and New Zealand. Transition to a relaxed dinner at the resort's main restaurant.

meals.breakfast: Late in-villa breakfast — eggs any style, freshly squeezed juices, Maldivian bis keemiya (stuffed pastries), and tropical fruit
meals.lunch: Post-excursion lunch at the resort's lagoon-facing café — tuna carpaccio, grilled vegetable flatbreads, and fresh coconut water
meals.dinner: Dinner at the resort's main fine-dining restaurant — pan-seared duck breast, truffle risotto, and a chocolate fondant dessert with gold leaf

day_by_day.notes: The Underwater Spa Treatment is one of the most exclusive offerings — book immediately upon arrival. Confirm the dolphin excursion departure time (typically early morning or late afternoon for best sightings).

day_by_day.morning: Participate in the Maldivian Cooking Class & Local Food Tour led by the resort's head chef. Begin with a tour of the resort's herb garden and a visit to the local fishing village (by boat) to source fresh ingredients. Learn to prepare traditional Maldivian dishes including mas huni (tuna and coconut salad), garudhiya (fish broth), and coconut-based curries.
day_by_day.afternoon: Enjoy the fruits of your cooking labor with a private lunch featuring the dishes you prepared. Spend the afternoon kayaking or paddleboarding through the resort's lagoon, exploring nearby sandbanks and shallow reef areas at your own pace.
day_by_day.evening: Dress for a special evening — your butler arranges a private overwater bungalow dinner setup with floating candles, flower petals on the water, and a personalized menu. Toast to your honeymoon with a bottle of vintage Krug Champagne.

meals.breakfast: Breakfast at the resort's main restaurant buffet — an extensive spread of international and Maldivian options including fresh pastries, live egg station, and tropical fruits
meals.lunch: Private lunch featuring your cooking class creations — mas huni, fish curry, roshi flatbreads, and fresh coconut toddy (non-alcoholic version available)
meals.dinner: Private overwater dinner — bespoke 7-course tasting menu with Maldivian and contemporary fusion dishes, Krug Champagne, and a personalized honeymoon dessert

day_by_day.notes: The cooking class typically lasts 3-4 hours. Confirm dietary restrictions with the chef beforehand. The overwater dinner setup requires advance booking and is subject to weather conditions.

day_by_day.morning: Dedicate the morning to pure relaxation — sleep in, enjoy breakfast in bed, and spend time lounging on your private beachfront terrace. Optional: Join a guided morning meditation session on the beach led by the resort's wellness guru, followed by a sound healing bowl session.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take a private snorkeling excursion to a nearby uninhabited island reef — your guide takes you to a secluded spot known for manta ray sightings (seasonal). Snorkel alongside these graceful giants in their natural habitat. Return to the resort for a refreshing dip in your private plunge pool.
day_by_day.evening: Experience the Bioluminescent Night Snorkeling Experience — after sunset, wade into the warm ocean waters and witness the magical glow of bioluminescent plankton lighting up electric blue around every movement. A truly otherworldly and unforgettable romantic experience.

meals.breakfast: Breakfast in bed — continental spread with freshly baked croissants, smoked salmon, fresh berries, and a Bellini cocktail
meals.lunch: Beachside barbecue lunch — freshly grilled lobster, tiger prawns, and reef fish with garlic butter, served with a chilled Sancerre
meals.dinner: Post-bioluminescence dinner at the resort's casual beach bar restaurant — wood-fired pizzas, fresh seafood pasta, and a dessert platter under the stars

day_by_day.notes: Bioluminescent snorkeling is best on moonless nights — confirm the lunar calendar with the activities desk. Manta ray sightings are seasonal (March is within the peak season for the North Malé Atoll area).

day_by_day.morning: Midpoint of your trip — treat yourselves to a full morning spa day. Begin with a private couple's hammam ritual, followed by a Javanese lulur body scrub and a hot stone massage. The resort's spa therapists use locally sourced ingredients including turmeric, sandalwood, and coconut.
day_by_day.afternoon: Enjoy a leisurely afternoon exploring the resort's private island on foot or by bicycle. Discover hidden beach coves, the resort's coral nursery program, and the overwater yoga pavilion. Optional: Join a guided snorkeling tour of the resort's coral restoration project — learn about Maldivian marine conservation efforts.
day_by_day.evening: Head to the resort's overwater cocktail lounge for sunset cocktails — try signature Maldivian-inspired drinks featuring local fruits like bilimbi and drumstick flower. Follow with dinner at the resort's Japanese-Maldivian fusion restaurant (if available) or the main fine dining venue.

meals.breakfast: Pre-spa nourishing breakfast at the wellness café — overnight oats, green juices, poached eggs on avocado toast, and herbal teas
meals.lunch: Light spa lunch delivered to the treatment pavilion — cold-pressed juices, grain bowls, and raw energy bites
meals.dinner: Fusion dinner at the resort's specialty restaurant — wagyu beef tataki, tuna sashimi with Maldivian spices, and matcha panna cotta for dessert

day_by_day.notes: Book the full-day spa package in advance as slots fill quickly. The coral nursery snorkeling tour is complimentary for resort guests and contributes to reef conservation — a meaningful and educational experience.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early for a sunrise fishing excursion on a traditional dhoni — try your hand at traditional Maldivian line fishing in the deep blue waters surrounding the atoll. Your guide teaches traditional techniques, and any catch can be prepared by the resort's chef for a special meal.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return with your catch and head to the resort's beach kitchen where the chef prepares your fish in your preferred style — grilled, Maldivian curry, or sashimi. Spend the afternoon relaxing at the pool with a good book and personalized cocktail service.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a second Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise — this time themed as a floating cocktail party for two, with a dedicated bartender mixing bespoke cocktails aboard the dhoni as the sun dips below the horizon.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast before fishing — fresh fruit, granola, and strong Maldivian coffee
meals.lunch: Chef-prepared lunch featuring your morning catch — grilled reef fish with lemon butter, Maldivian coconut rice, and fresh salad
meals.dinner: Dinner at the resort's beach restaurant — a la carte menu with fresh oysters, beef tenderloin, and a classic crème brûlée

day_by_day.notes: Sunrise fishing requires a 5:30 AM departure — arrange an early wake-up call with your butler. Confirm with the chef in advance about preparing your catch for lunch.

day_by_day.morning: Embark on a full-day private island hopping excursion by luxury speedboat. Visit a local inhabited island to experience authentic Maldivian village life — explore the narrow streets, visit a local school or mosque (with permission), and shop for handcrafted lacquerware and woven mats at the local market.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the island hopping to a pristine uninhabited sandbank for a private picnic lunch set up by the resort. Snorkel the surrounding reef, sunbathe on the white sand, and enjoy complete seclusion. Your butler and a chef accompany you for a truly bespoke experience.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort refreshed. Enjoy a quiet evening with a couples' stargazing session on your private beach — the resort's astronomy guide sets up a telescope and narrates the Southern Hemisphere's constellations over a bottle of fine wine.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast before departure — fresh pastries, tropical fruits, and Maldivian tea
meals.lunch: Private sandbank picnic — gourmet hamper with charcuterie, artisan cheeses, fresh lobster rolls, tropical fruits, and a chilled bottle of Whispering Angel rosé
meals.dinner: Intimate dinner on your villa's private terrace — chef's table experience with a personalized 5-course menu prepared and served exclusively for you

day_by_day.notes: Island hopping excursion requires advance booking and is weather-dependent. Respect local customs when visiting inhabited islands — dress modestly (cover shoulders and knees). The chef's table private villa dinner should be booked 48 hours in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Dedicate the morning to a second visit to Banana Reef or a nearby outer reef for a more advanced snorkeling session — this time focusing on deeper reef walls and channels where larger pelagic species such as eagle rays and whale sharks (seasonal) may be spotted. Your private guide accompanies you throughout.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort for a rejuvenating afternoon. Book a private couple's facial and body treatment at the spa — the resort's signature 'Ocean Ritual' using sea kelp, marine collagen, and deep-sea minerals. Follow with a dip in the spa's hydrotherapy pool.
day_by_day.evening: Celebrate the penultimate days of your honeymoon with a special cocktail masterclass for two — the resort's head bartender teaches you to craft three signature Maldivian cocktails using local ingredients. Then enjoy a relaxed dinner at the resort's casual beachside venue.

meals.breakfast: Breakfast at the resort's main restaurant — eggs Benedict with smoked tuna, fresh juices, and Maldivian sweet bread
meals.lunch: Post-snorkeling light lunch at the lagoon café — tuna poke bowls, edamame, and chilled green tea
meals.dinner: Beachside casual dinner — wood-fired grilled seafood platter, garlic naan, and a shared dessert fondue

day_by_day.notes: Whale shark sightings are not guaranteed but March falls within a favorable season around South Ari Atoll — ask the activities desk about day-trip options if whale shark snorkeling is a priority.

day_by_day.morning: Begin the morning with a private stand-up paddleboard yoga session on the calm lagoon waters — a unique and meditative experience combining balance, mindfulness, and the beauty of the ocean. Follow with a nourishing breakfast at the wellness pavilion.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend a free afternoon doing exactly what you love most — whether that's snorkeling the house reef one last time, lounging in your private plunge pool, shopping at the resort's boutique for Maldivian crafts and luxury souvenirs, or simply napping in a hammock between two palm trees.
day_by_day.evening: Your butler arranges a special anniversary/honeymoon surprise dinner setup — a floating flower and candle arrangement in your villa's private pool, with a dedicated chef preparing an intimate dinner beside it. The resort's musician performs live acoustic guitar or traditional bodu beru drumming.

meals.breakfast: Wellness breakfast at the pavilion — smoothie bowls, chia pudding, avocado toast, and fresh coconut water
meals.lunch: Poolside snacking — gourmet sliders, truffle fries, fresh fruit skewers, and signature mocktails
meals.dinner: Private villa pool dinner — 7-course chef's tasting menu with wine pairing, live music, and a personalized honeymoon cake

day_by_day.notes: Coordinate the surprise dinner setup with your butler at least 2 days in advance. Request any special honeymoon touches — personalized menu cards, monogrammed napkins, or a custom dessert message.

day_by_day.morning: Final full morning — wake up early for one last sunrise snorkel on the house reef, savoring every moment of the underwater world that has defined this trip. Take underwater photos with a GoPro (available for rent from the resort) to capture lasting memories.
day_by_day.afternoon: Enjoy a farewell spa treatment — a 90-minute couple's relaxation massage to unwind and prepare for the journey ahead. Spend the remaining afternoon packing, lounging, and soaking in the last views of your beachfront paradise. Take a final swim in the Indian Ocean.
day_by_day.evening: Host your own private farewell dinner at the resort's finest dining venue — order your favorite dishes from the trip and request the sommelier to pair the meal with exceptional wines. Reflect on the incredible journey over a final glass of champagne as the Maldivian stars appear overhead.

meals.breakfast: Final in-villa breakfast — a special spread arranged by your butler featuring all your favorite items from the trip
meals.lunch: Leisurely lunch at the overwater restaurant — grilled mahi-mahi, fresh ceviche, and a chilled glass of Chablis
meals.dinner: Grand farewell dinner at the resort's signature fine-dining restaurant — best-of menu featuring highlights from the trip, a champagne toast, and a personalized dessert platter

day_by_day.notes: Request the resort to prepare a personalized photo book or memory card of your stay if they offer this service. Confirm checkout time and departure transfer logistics with your butler for the following morning.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a final leisurely breakfast at the resort before checkout. Your butler assists with luggage and ensures a seamless VIP departure. Take one last walk along your private beach, breathe in the salt air, and bid farewell to your paradise. Transfer to Malé International Airport via private seaplane or speedboat, with resort staff seeing you off with garlands and warm Maldivian hospitality.
day_by_day.afternoon: Departure — carry the memories of 13 extraordinary days in the Maldives as you board your flight home.
day_by_day.evening: In transit — relive the magic of your honeymoon.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast — a lavish spread at the main restaurant or a special in-villa farewell breakfast arranged by your butler
meals.lunch: Light snacks and refreshments at the resort's departure lounge or during transfer
meals.dinner: In-flight or at transit airport — premium dining options depending on airline and layover

day_by_day.notes: Allow at least 3 hours before your flight for seaplane/speedboat transfer and airport check-in. Request the resort to arrange a farewell gift hamper with Maldivian teas, spices, and locally made crafts as a memento of your honeymoon.
